description: This file defines the TimesheetItemDecorator class, which provides methods to decorate and manipulate TimesheetItem entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting related project, project activity, timesheet, and employee entities by their IDs, as well as formatting the start date of a timesheet item.

classes.name: TimesheetItemDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for TimesheetItem entities, providing utility methods for setting related entities and formatting date information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TimesheetItemDecorator with a given TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Associates a Project entity to the timesheet item based on the provided project ID.

methods.name: setProjectActivityById
methods.description: Associates a ProjectActivity entity to the timesheet item based on the provided ID.

methods.name: setTimesheetById
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet entity to the timesheet item based on the provided timesheet ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the timesheet item based on the provided employee number.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the timesheet item formatted as a string.
